info.name: Marketplace — Customer API
info.description:
Full collection for the Customer-facing API (`routes/api_customer.php` + `routes/api_customer_v1.php`), guard `auth:customer` (JWT).

**Getting started**
1. Set `base_url` (collection variable) to your environment, e.g. `https://api.marketplace.test`.
2. Set `country` (collection variable) to the site code, e.g. `eg`, `ae`.
3. Run **Auth → Login** (or Register) once — its test script automatically saves `access_token` and `refresh_token` into collection variables. Every other request in this collection inherits Bearer auth from the collection level, so you never need to paste the token manually again.
4. Guest-cart endpoints (Cart folder) instead use the `X-Cart-Token` header, captured automatically into `guest_cart_token` the first time you call **Cart → Get Cart** or **Add Cart Item** without being logged in.

All request bodies document each field's type/required/description in the request description panel. All requests include a saved 200/201 response example with complete, realistic (fake) data.
